svg.title: Step 8: the 30-day check-in
svg.desc: A big wall calendar shows 30 days, with small bells on the warning days 14, 7, 3 and 1. An arrow leads to a fresh calendar page marked 30, with a big green tick. The admin taps a phone that shows a tick. In a dashed corner note, a small server machine with its lights on sits beside the words If you miss it: keeps running.
